goal: Freeze cosmetic convergence work on the current search shell while the new AnyTour design is being finalized. Use this lane only to prepare safe migration boundaries and avoid polishing UI that is expected to be replaced.

design_approval.evidence: AnyTour Design System 2.0 is the approved active design contract in autopilot-v2/project-contract.json; material visual changes still require their own risk-scoped visual QA.

never_touch: Design System 1.0 or any retired parallel visual system
AnyTour logo asset or brand identity
invariants: Design System 2.0 is the only active design system
no new parallel header, footer or shell variant is introduced
material visual redesign requires approved prototype before implementation
small regression fixes may proceed without a new prototype when they preserve the approved DS2 direction
done_when: no cosmetic restyling of the current shell is implemented before the new mockups are approved
only migration-safe structural preparation is allowed when it directly reduces future redesign work
current production visuals are changed only for an actual bug or lead-impacting defect
once approved mockups are available, this task is replaced by narrow implementation contracts for the new design
